product_model_rule: The learned candidate with the lowest full-development date-macro MAE in this run. It is fixed by that rule before the reserve is scored and is not changed by reserve results. The tool always displays the product forecast beside the activity/coordination comparator and persistence.

outcome_quality_sensitivity.rule: Cases whose day-12 plate zero-dose median ns.n is at least 5. This uses a future observation, so it is a reporting subset for target reliability only; it never enters any feature, decision, or model.
